strings.dnd_hint: (ko ja fayil ɗin zuwa wannan taga)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ja da sauke ba ya samuwa. Yi amfani da maɓallin da ke ƙasa.
strings.shred_button: L A L A T A
strings.ssd_warning:
Gargaɗi! A kan SSD hanyar sake rubutu ba ta ba da tabbacin lalata ba saboda TRIM.
Shirin na HDD ne.
strings.confirm_text:
Za a sake rubuta fayil ɗin "{name}" kuma a goge shi.

Ci gaba?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?

The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  AN SAKE RUBUTA KUMA AN GODE FAYIL ɗIN
strings.report_limits:
• Ba a sarrafa madadin rafukan bayanai na NTFS (ADS).
• Ba a share littafin USN ba.
• Kwafin inuwa da daidaitawar girgije
  (OneDrive da sauransu) ba a shafe su ba.
strings.status_full: An sake rubuta abin ciki gaba ɗaya da sifili. Maido da shi ba zai yiwu ba — kayan aiki za su ga sifili kawai.
strings.status_fast: An sake rubuta kai, wutsiya da ratsin 4 MB. Sauran ba a taɓa su ba, amma saboda gibin, cikakken maidowa ta kayan aikin mabukaci ba zai yiwu ba. Don takardu na sirri yi amfani da yanayin CIKAKKE.
strings.status_empty: Fayil ɗin babu komai, ba a buƙatar sake rubutu ba. An goge shi.
strings.error_permission: Ba za a iya samun damar fayil ɗin ba. Wataƙila yana buɗe a wani shiri. Rufe shi kuma sake gwadawa.
strings.error_not_found: Ba a sami fayil ɗin ba. Wataƙila an riga an goge shi.
strings.error_unknown: Kuskuren da ba a zata ba: {err}
strings.error_is_symlink: Wannan alama ce ta haɗi. Ba za a iya lalata hanyoyin haɗi ba — fayil ɗin manufa zai kasance cikakke.
strings.error_reparse: Wannan fayil ɗin ma'auni ne (OneDrive ko makamancinsa). Bayanansa suna cikin girgije, ba a kan faifai ba — babu abin da za a lalata a nan.
strings.error_not_file: Wannan ba fayil ba ne (babban fayil ko wani abu). Sauke fayil.
strings.error_hardlinks: Wannan fayil ɗin yana da wasu ƙaƙƙarfan hanyoyin haɗi ({n} gaba ɗaya). Ƙaƙƙarfan hanyoyin haɗi ba su da na farko — duk sunaye daidai suke. Idan ka lalata ta hanyar yanzu, za a sake rubuta bayanan kuma a yanke su zuwa baiti 32, amma ragowar za su kasance ana iya samun su ta wasu hanyoyin. Da farko goge duk hanyoyin.
strings.error_compressed:
An matse fayil ɗin, an ɓoye shi, ko ba shi da yawa. Sake rubutu da sifili ba ya ba da tabbacin lalata tsoffin bayanai saboda NTFS na adana su daban.

Cire siffar: danna dama → Kaddarori → Ci gaba → cire alamar "Matsa" da/ko "Ɓoye". Sannan sake gudanar da SHREDDER.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Za a lalata fayiloli {count}.
Jimillar girma: {size}.

Duba jerin kafin ci gaba.
Wannan aikin ba zai iya jurewa ba.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Cire duk fayiloli {count} daga jerin?

Ba za a taɓa fayilolin ba — jeri kawai.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fayil "{name}" yana da wasu hanyoyin haɗi ({nlink} gaba ɗaya).

Za a lalata bayanai don duk sunaye.
Amma ragowar (32 bytes) za su kasance ƙarƙashin wasu sunaye a cikin babban fayil ɗin.

Kuna iya buƙatar share waɗannan ragowar da hannu.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Aiwatar ga duk hanyoyin haɗi a cikin jeri
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: ba za a iya karanta girman ba
